referencePolicy: Command & Conquer 3: Tiberium Wars, Supreme Commander 2, XCOM 2 and StarCraft II are visual-language references only. No protected asset, map, building, unit, material, decal, symbol, logo, UI, organism, palette or named landmark may be copied or traced. Every output must be original MASSFRONT work with provenance; recolor-only variants are forbidden.

planets.biome: tidally locked super-Earth with a vitrified dayside, copper terminator ribbon, methane-frost nightside, blade-basalt uplifts and black-brine fracture lakes
planets.atmosphere: thin copper-red terminator haze, cold blue-black nightside limb and high-altitude eclipse-dust veils
planets.hazards: thermal shock, methane frost, eclipse cold fronts, brine overpressure, brittle basalt and moon-driven fault motion
planets.orbitalSilhouette: hard white-gold day scar, broad copper terminator, dark frozen hemisphere and one visibly fractured moon
planets.terrainMaterialGrammar: sintered black basalt, pale aerogel, copper thermal buses, frosted nickel, amber status emission and black-brine deposits
planets.factionLoreContext: Orion Cryosphere frontier where settlements survive only along the terminator and every structure exposes a believable thermal-management function.

planets.biome: canon volcanic hiveworld of violet-brown ashlands, Caldera Nests, Infestation Fields, Magma Hatcheries and a green-black Overgrown Front
planets.atmosphere: low magenta-lilac dusk beneath ash-spore belts, orange volcanic plumes and a bruised violet limb
planets.hazards: magma, ash, acidic ichor, spore exposure, hostile vascular encroachment, membrane breach and collapsing infested infrastructure
planets.orbitalSilhouette: continent-scale caldera chains, orange magma fractures, asymmetric infestation scars, overgrown plateau front and broken captured ring debris
planets.terrainMaterialGrammar: vitrified forge refractory, violet-brown ash mineral, failed colony composite, calcified chitin, vascular tissue, acid contact and restrained neural emission
planets.factionLoreContext: Existing canon Brood hiveworld. Brood is the hostile galactic enemy, non-playable and non-humanoid; its ecology invades or digests earlier infrastructure rather than presenting usable faction buildings.

planets.biome: high-gravity tectonic world of red iron knife-ranges, cobalt rift lakes, fault terraces and deep mantle elevators
planets.atmosphere: compressed ochre atmosphere filled with migrating metallic dust cyclones and sharp cobalt rift haze
planets.hazards: seismic pulses, fault shear, conductive dust, elevator failure, landslip and high-gravity structural fatigue
planets.orbitalSilhouette: red knife-range continents split by cobalt rifts with a thin equatorial debris braid and two shepherd moons
planets.terrainMaterialGrammar: layered iron slate, red shock armor, bronze counterweights, white stress ceramics, cobalt pressure glass and heat-glazed bore liners
planets.factionLoreContext: Helios Quarantine extraction world where mechanically explicit shock isolation dominates. Optional lithovore Brood appears only as hostile non-humanoid silicate-chitin fault grafts.

planets.biome: humid dim world of continent-scale fungal forests, hollow shelf mesas, phosphorescent spore rivers and seasonal canopy blooms
planets.atmosphere: deep amber-green humid limb with pearl bloom storms and drifting luminous spore deltas
planets.hazards: toxic bloom intake, spore saturation, wet-root subsidence, canopy collapse, membrane contamination and parasitic grafting
planets.orbitalSilhouette: pale shelf-forest continents, dark teal seas, spiral bloom storms, porous moon and faint polar spore torus
planets.terrainMaterialGrammar: elevated white ceramic roots, amber pressure membrane, wet shelf bark, resin-process surfaces and sharply distinct black-red parasitic vascular grafts
planets.factionLoreContext: Helios Quarantine xenobiology frontier where native fungal ecology is protected. Optional Brood parasitism consumes that ecology as hostile non-humanoid grafting and never becomes a playable organism set.

planets.biome: cool ocean world of black ferrous brine, rust-red tidal marshes, salt-ice shelves and long floodable causeways
planets.atmosphere: blue-grey maritime atmosphere with low storm bands, salt fog and strong two-moon tides
planets.hazards: storm surge, salt corrosion, ballast failure, ferrous brine overpressure, causeway shear and amphibious siphon-reef intrusion
planets.orbitalSilhouette: black seas, red tidal deltas, white salt shelves and two unequal moons producing visible tide bulges
planets.terrainMaterialGrammar: pale saltcrete, dark marine titanium, red buoyancy ceramic, teal navigation resin, ferrous wetline deposits and optional low amphibious siphon-reef contact
planets.factionLoreContext: Helios Quarantine tidal frontier of floodable infrastructure. Optional Brood ecology takes the form of hostile non-humanoid siphon reefs consuming pumps and gates, never a usable settlement skin.

planets.biome: dense-atmosphere frontier of slate mesas, permanent silver fog seas, black fern forests and storm-cut chasms
planets.atmosphere: deep blue-grey air with global silver fog basins, towering white storm anvils and copper lightning scars
planets.hazards: visibility loss, charge buildup, lightning strike, condensate flashover, wet landslip and suspended-deck failure
planets.orbitalSilhouette: dark mesa islands above bright fog seas, three-dimensional storm anvils and a small moon carving a moving clear wake
planets.terrainMaterialGrammar: wet slate, matte blue composite, copper lightning drains, silver condensate deposits, fog-seal glass and dark anti-slip decks
planets.factionLoreContext: Veyra Frontier weather-harvesting and navigation corridor where strong silhouette beacons, elevated piers and electrical grounding make every site readable through fog.

planets.biome: dry high-albedo world of white salt plateaus, ochre shadow basins, turquoise mineral sinkholes and heliostat fields
planets.atmosphere: thin bright atmosphere with a narrow ultraviolet auroral crown, high pale dust and severe dayward glare
planets.hazards: ultraviolet flare, reflector misalignment, thermal fracture, salt-dust abrasion and cooling-system failure
planets.orbitalSilhouette: white continents, dark thermal rifts, turquoise sinkholes, restrained gold heliostat traces and violet auroral crown
planets.terrainMaterialGrammar: shaded saltstone, matte white ceramic, black thermal composite, fine gold reflector structures, blue cooling ceramic and disciplined status emission
planets.factionLoreContext: Veyra Frontier solar-thermal and mineral research world where visual brightness comes from material response and shade engineering, not excessive bloom.

planets.biome: dry world of bone-white karst, ochre dry seabeds, black flint ridges and enormous exposed fossil reef systems
planets.atmosphere: thin blue-grey dusty air with broad basin haze and wind-polished clear upper sky
planets.hazards: karst sink, dust burial, fossil collapse, kiln overfire, aquifer loss and brittle flint landslide
planets.orbitalSilhouette: white karst continents, ochre basins, black flint ridges, two irregular moons and a broken pale ring
planets.terrainMaterialGrammar: lime ceramic, weathered fossil calcite, black flint and steel, blue shade fabric, pale hydraulic concrete and dry-basin dust
planets.factionLoreContext: Veyra Frontier heritage and paleontology reserve. Fossils remain protected natural history rather than Brood or faction architecture; manufactured forms stay visibly mechanical.

planets.biome: cold tectonic world of charcoal underplates, pale birefringent mineral shelves, clear glacial lakes and sparse faceted ridges
planets.atmosphere: cold clear limb with polarized violet-green auroras, thin ice clouds and controlled optical haze
planets.hazards: optical sensor bloom, frost stress, glacial fracture, mineral-shelf collapse and actuator icing
planets.orbitalSilhouette: charcoal plates edged by pale shelves, blue lakes, polarized aurora and a thin ring of shard-like moon debris
planets.terrainMaterialGrammar: charcoal structural composite, milk-glass ceramic, restrained birefringent mineral trim, frosted instrument surfaces and precise spectral wayfinding
planets.factionLoreContext: Veyra Frontier optical-materials world where color is angle-dependent and functional. It forbids rainbow repainting, all-over crystal spikes and invisible gameplay geometry.

planets.biome: low-gravity storm world of shallow cobalt oceans, ochre tablelands, electromagnetic mineral shelves and fast cloud rivers
planets.atmosphere: deep blue-white jet bands, dark storm eyes, extreme shear layers and three small shepherd moons
planets.hazards: jet-stream shear, tension failure, anchor loss, charged aerosol, tableland edge collapse and low-gravity debris travel
planets.orbitalSilhouette: cobalt shallows, ochre tablelands, a few visibly shadowed levitated shelves, white jet bands and three shepherd moons
planets.terrainMaterialGrammar: flexible graphite roads, black tension pylons, orange aerodynamic shells, storm-weathered composite and restrained navigation emission
planets.factionLoreContext: Perseus Expanse exploration and atmospheric-harvesting frontier. Every settlement is mechanically anchored; the module contains ground operations and no space combat.
